The following trends were identified for MOV frequency of demands or events in the most recent 10-year period: • Increasing trend in the low-demand MOV frequency of FTOC demands (demands per reactor year), which is extremely statistically significant with a p-value of 0.000 (see Figure 7). The same trend was observed in the 2022, 2020, 2018, and 2016 MOV update studies [2], [9]–[11] as extremely or highly statistically significant. • Decreasing trend in the low-demand MOV frequency of FTOC events (events per reactor year), which is highly statistically significant with a p-value of 0.006 (see Figure 9). The same trend was observed in the 2022, 2020, 2018, and 2016 MOV update studies [2], [9]–[11] as extremely statistically significant, highly statistically significant, or statistically significant. • Decreasing trend in the high-demand MOV frequency of SO events (events per reactor year), which is statistically significant with a p-value of 0.046 (see Figure 14).
